items.title: Add speakable blocks on service intros
items.body: Add schema.org speakable specification on service intro paragraphs for voice assistants / Gemini Live. With the citation-ready 40–60 word answers now in place (item #31 shipped 2026-05-17), wrapping them in a speakable block is the natural follow-up — gives voice assistants a single span to read aloud rather than guessing. DOWNWEIGHTED 2026-08-07: the Ahrefs schema-impact study (+2.4% AI Mode / +2.2% ChatGPT / –4.6% AIO across 1,885 pages) held up in late-July commentary; consensus is schema is a context signal, not a lever. Speakable specifically has been in beta 7 years without leaving beta. Keep on the list because it's still cheap, but do NOT invest engineering time in more schema types over body-copy work. RE-CONFIRMED 2026-08-28: no new schema uplift studies published this week; Schema.org v30 is stable (Physician type now exclusively subtype of MedicalOrganization; PhysiciansOffice restored to MedicalBusiness) but neither change opens a new opportunity type for us — our Physician-schema upgrade (item #27 shipped) remains current.

items.title: Auto-fetch Google Business Profile reviews at build time
items.body: So reviewCount / ratingValue stay current without manual edits. Build script hits Places API with a 24h cache. REINFORCED 2026-08-07: Whitespark's 2026 Local Search Ranking Factors report now names review recency as the #1 individual local ranking factor (reviews <30 days carry full algorithmic weight; 30–180 days decays to 10–20%; 73% of consumers only trust reviews from the last month per Epicware July 2026). Gemini and AI Overviews now use review sentiment + keywords to pick which local businesses to recommend, so review freshness feeds both the Local Pack AND the AI-citation layer. Combined with #16, this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end — bump up in effective priority even though tier stays 2. RE-CONFIRMED 2026-08-28: multiple 2026 local-SEO ranking-factor breakdowns (Seahawk, PinMeTo, RankMax, JC WebPros) consistently put GBP signals at 32% of the total local ranking weight and reviews at 16% — those two together are nearly half. This item + #16 sits at the intersection.

items.title: Start a blog (2 posts/month)
files: PR #108 Practitioner Spotlight infra can be extended rather than a from-scratch build
items.body: Short evidence-based articles per condition. Each post: author byline with Physician schema, datePublished, dateModified, 3–5 FAQs. Ahrefs analysis of 17M AI citations (April 2026) found AI-cited content is 25.7% fresher than traditional Google organic results — 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within the last 30 days. Freshness compounds. Confirmed 2026-08-07: 70% of AI Overview cited pages churn within 2–3 months (Search Engine Journal July 2026 AI-Mode-after-one-year study); pages updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. osteopath-christchurch.com still owns headaches/cranial/baby/teeth-grinding/stress/arthritis queries on the strength of one short blog post per condition; MK Osteopathy still owns TMJ the same way; headachetendon.nz (a chiropractor) still #1 for 'lower back pain christchurch' this run (2 consecutive weeks). STARTING POINT: PR #108's Practitioner Spotlight infrastructure — the Decap collection config, JSON-LD, homepage surface and image handling can be adapted rather than built from scratch. Consensus in late-July commentary: depth > velocity — 2 posts/month is fine if each is genuinely useful. UPDATED 2026-08-28 — RELATIVE PRIORITY UP: with off-site AI leverage via Reddit having just fragmented (see #15 and G15), first-party on-site freshness is proportionally more of the whole GEO strategy than it was last week. Tier stays 3 (still a large effort) but this is now the single biggest lever on the backlog whose payoff has grown.

items.title: Seed Reddit / community brand mentions — now Perplexity-only
items.body: REWRITTEN 2026-08-28 — MAJOR DELEVERAGING: last week's version framed Reddit seeding as the single highest-leverage AEO lever we had, because Reddit was 46.7% of Perplexity top-10 citation share AND ~5% of ChatGPT — i.e. leverage across the two dominant AI-search surfaces at once. That is no longer true. Between Aug 5–8 Reddit's ChatGPT-Search citation share collapsed 86% (3.8% → 0.5%). The cause is a mix of (a) an OpenAI backend change to ChatGPT's query-fanout that stopped surfacing Reddit URLs as visible citations and/or (b) Reddit re-blocking non-licensed AI crawlers via robots.txt (its Google licensing situation is still contested); Reddit now behaves as a 'silent source' for ChatGPT — read during retrieval but no longer credited in visible citations. Perplexity moved in the opposite direction: its Reddit citations roughly doubled Jul→Aug and kept climbing. Of 44,488 Reddit citations tracked Jul 1–Aug 19, Perplexity supplied 71% and ChatGPT 23%. Practical implication: Reddit seeding for AI visibility is now a Perplexity-focused play, not a broad AI-search play. Perplexity's market share is materially smaller than ChatGPT's, so the ROI of the seed-r/newzealand-with-non-promotional-answers programme has fallen substantially in a single quarter. IMPACT dropped M → L; EFFORT unchanged; TIER stays 3. Do NOT invest editorial time here as a priority; if a Meridian-relevant Reddit thread arises organically (a genuine question in r/chch about ACC osteopathy, dry needling vs acupuncture, concussion recovery), a thoughtful non-promotional answer is still cheap AI-visibility for Perplexity/ClaudeBot pathways, but do not run a proactive seeding campaign. First-party on-site freshness (#14) is now the higher-leverage substitute for AI-visibility work.

Healthcare best-practice = at least 1 new review/week. Combined with #13 (auto-fetch reviews at build time), this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end. items.title: Add /conditions/concussion/ page — SERP volatility + a new #1 entrant this run
items.body: First check 2026-05-22 of 'concussion osteopath christchurch' showed triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz at #1, osteo.co.nz/concussion/ at #2, triskelionosteopathy.co.nz/concussion/ at #3. Reinforced 2026-06-05 + 2026-08-07: same dominant Triskelion + Better Health + osteo.co.nz + Moorhouse + HeadWise + Halswell set. UPDATED 2026-08-28 — SERP MORE CONTESTED: (1) 'concussion osteopath christchurch' — osteo.co.nz holds #1 for a second consecutive week (took it from long-standing triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz two weeks ago); triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz slipped to #5. christchurch-osteopathy-acupuncture.co.nz new to top 5 via its /cranialosteopathy page. (2) 'post concussion syndrome christchurch' — NEW #1 ENTRANT: completeconcussions.com (a chain) via 'The Headache Clinic Christchurch' subdomain page; Triskelion holds #2; axissportsmedicine.co.nz new to top 5. This is the most contested the concussion SERP has been at any prior check — the Triskelion brand's dominance is genuinely eroding. Concussion is high-value, ACC-adjacent injury content (post-concussion symptoms — headaches, dizziness, fatigue, brain fog — overlap directly with headache/migraine and neck pain conditions we already treat). The smallest fix is a /conditions/concussion/ page mirroring the existing pattern (sciatica, neck-pain, back-pain, headaches-migraines, pregnancy-back-pain, sports-injury-recovery): MedicalCondition + FAQPage schema, 40–60 word citation-ready intro (per #31's pattern), structured 5–7 item list blocks (per #34's pattern), acute-vs-chronic / when-to-seek-urgent-care / ACC eligibility (matching PR #113's provider-status framing, not claim-filing mechanics) / how osteopathy fits / book-now sections. Add corresponding entry to conditions.json (including the `lists` array structure introduced in #34) and a tile in the homepage 'Common conditions we treat' grid. Page pattern exists to copy; effort S.

items.title: Enable Google Search Console Generative AI performance report + capture baseline
items.body: Google launched a dedicated Generative AI performance report in Search Console on 2026-06-03 that tracks impressions for AI Overviews and AI Mode, broken down by pages, countries, devices and dates at hourly through monthly granularity. UPDATED 2026-08-14: multiple August 2026 write-ups (Pragma-Code, Weblumino, TJ Robertson, SmartTeam) confirmed the Gen AI panel is STILL impressions-only — no CTR, no clicks, no query data. The end-to-end 'AI-surface → click → booking' attribution story pairs with the STANDARD Performance report's existing CTR column, not the Gen AI panel, until Google actually ships CTR there. UPDATED 2026-08-28 — DATA-QUALITY CAVEAT: Google confirmed a logging error caused a decrease in reported impressions on the Generative AI performance report for data starting Aug 13 and continuing through Aug 17 (also affected Discover Gen AI impressions). This is a data-side bug ONLY, NOT a visibility change (Google confirmed via Search Central annotation). When comparing forward from the pre-Aug 13 baseline (~2 months of pre-blog data), TREAT Aug 13–17 as unusable data and use Aug 8–12 as the immediate comparison anchor. The report opt-out toggle went live 2026-06-17 (72+ days ago); since properties are opt-in by default, the report should still be capturing unless explicitly disabled. Action items: (1) verify meridianosteopathy.co.nz is a verified property in the clinic's GSC account, (2) confirm the AI Overviews / AI Mode toggle is still ON, (3) screenshot the report's default 3-month window as a 'pre-blog' baseline (excluding Aug 13–17 explicitly) before item #14 ships, (4) build the AI-surface-attribution story on Performance-report CTR paired with the GA4 booking_completed event added in PR #116, NOT on a Gen-AI-panel CTR column that does not yet exist. No code changes needed.

items.title: Add a postpartum recovery section or dedicated /conditions/postpartum-recovery/ page
items.body: First-run check 2026-08-14 of 'postpartum osteopath christchurch' returned only 6 total Google results — an unusually thin SERP for a Christchurch health query. UPDATED 2026-08-28 — SERP FILLED IN: this run returned a full page of ~10 results (betterhealthosteopathy.nz, osteo.co.nz, dunstanosteopathy.com, porthillsosteo.co.nz, osteopath-christchurch.com and pregnancy/postnatal aggregators). The thin-SERP window that made this a low-hanging opportunity has closed inside two weeks — this now looks like typical Christchurch health-query competition rather than a unique gap. Content addition is still worth doing (US-variant 'postpartum' vs NZ-standard 'postnatal' is a real search-language variant Meridian doesn't currently index for, and the /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ page doesn't extend into non-pain postnatal recovery), but PRIORITY DOWNGRADED from 'easy win' to 'normal condition-page build'. Two implementation options: (a) EXTEND — add a 'Postpartum recovery' H2 section to the existing /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ page with US-spelling variants in body copy (postpartum, postnatal, post-birth) and appropriate MedicalCondition JSON-LD updates, keeping single-page authority; or (b) NEW PAGE — /conditions/postpartum-recovery/ following the standard condition-page pattern (MedicalCondition + FAQPage schema, 40–60 word citation-ready intro per #31, structured list blocks per #34), separate URL to catch the exact-slug search intent. Option (a) is smaller effort and now looks like the better call given the SERP is no longer thin — a section extension within an existing indexed URL is likely to outperform a brand-new URL competing against 10 established results. Option (b) is a legitimate alternative only if the sports-injury-recovery URL-slug precedent's exact-match effect is judged to override the general 'consolidate authority' principle here. Effort S either way.
